Type: stacked orb floor lamp

Style: glam, art deco, contemporary
Materials: polished nickel metal, black glossy drum shade
Colors: bright silver nickel, black
Shape: column of stacked shiny balls, round flared base, tapered black drum shade, tall and bold
Feel: glamorous, shiny, dramatic
Goes with: black and white palettes, mirrored furniture, velvet, grey walls; glam or Hollywood regency rooms

product.name: Pinzon Polished Nickel Orb Floor Lamp with Black Shade
product.description: Bright silver floor lamp with classic black drum shade beautifully enhances urban and modern decors Chrome-plated metal base; cotton shade; silver cord; matching finial Requires 1 bulb up to 100 watts; UL listed; 3-way switch for adjustable lighting Easy assembly required on arrival; matching table lamp available separately Measures 61 inches high by 14 inches wide; weighs approximately 18 pounds
